question_en:
After a sports museum moved its collection, temporary labels on several timing devices were misplaced. The physical object labeled `ENTRY` in the attachment is the starting point; the horizontal and vertical axis scale units are both centimeters, corresponding respectively to the first and second values of the official object page `Dimension` on the Olympic Museum website. At each intersection of the scales corresponding to these two values, read the image fragment of the next object; identify 7 objects in total. Please answer the following questions:

1. Which artifact does `ENTRY` correspond to? Please provide its official name, `Reference number`, and complete `Dimension`. Continuing the search according to the above dimension indexing rule, what are the subsequent 6 artifacts? Please list the official name, `Reference number`, and complete `Dimension` of all 7 artifacts in the order of the full chain.

Answer format: Use a table to list the official name, Reference number, and complete Dimension of the 7 artifacts in the order of the full chain; the first row is ENTRY, so there is no need to answer the starting point separately.
